policy.note: the P85 genesis terms of unicity-pos-contracts script/P85Genesis.s.sol (evidenceWindow 1000, holds 2000 rounds, timeFloor 3600 s); the exit maturity is the larger of the hold at the declared round time and the UC-time floor, plus a safety margin

features.election: authoritative hook; a second handoff driven on the accumulated chain; offence 2's lost result rejected by the roots
features.governance: queue early, execute late; activation asserted (the open results are resolved)
features.rewardPool: small separately funded genesis capital, exhaustion then fund()
features.faults: root quorum restart, validator restart, validator+execution client restart, all EVM validators down for 300 s while the roots extend (each in the four-member K')

steps.note: the lane-held authority queues a halved reward rate right after the first snapshot (B6e, gov-lib.sh)
decision (b): the joiner's install into J = K + joiner; labelled 'joiner install + recovery', not an ordinary acknowledged replacement (bft-core#777)
J stalls, then the derived recovery back to K
the held offender's identity asks to exit before its case is submitted; refused for EvidenceHoldPending while the case is admitted and unsettled
the joiner's root key (S4): delivered in epoch 2, submitted and settled after the recovery

the election result that opens after the recovery is driven to its Ack (bft-core#856, scripts/x4pos/handoff-lib.sh): proofs of possession, publication, the root-ordered plan with readiness receipts, the root install of epoch 4, the activation record, the validators into the new scope. K' is K's four members under a new assignment; K is closed. It runs after offence 1 settled and before offence 2, which excludes a fourth identity so that the election (nMin 4) can reserve nothing afterwards

root4, a staying member (B4): delivered in epoch 4 (after the second handoff) with its own evidence window; the result that opened after the handoff is marked lost on the admission and REJECTED by the roots (RejectResult of an unpublishable result, bft-core#857/#871), the running assignment untouched

at least 4 closed intervals on the contracts pin with the tail cap (#72): the ended segments of G, J and K and the tail of K', a pool that runs dry, the refill, a LATER interval paid after it, a payee's exact claim (B6c)
refused early for a lawful reason, then matured and claimed with exact amounts after the case settled

execute() after both delays (permissionless, schedules only), then the queued rate becomes the policy in force at the next election boundary (no result is open: ElectionPolicy.elect runs activateDue first) and the lane ASSERTS it
the four running roots restart together in the current root epoch; state identical, a paid transaction certifies
validator 2 stops and returns in its scope; its head catches up; a paid transaction certifies

validator 3's node AND its execution client restart: the retained block is byte-identical to validator 1's, the reward pool and the custody credits are unchanged (the reward-settling side resumes from durable state)

every online EVM validator (four) stops for 300 s while the roots keep extending (the shard's import of root extensions is delayed as a whole), then return: the registry log is ordered, the cursor converged, no gate state moved
the chain runs on its own; an accounting snapshot every 1200 s until the final reconcile at 14,400 s (the accounting span is the full interval)
the registry/custody cursors converged, a last snapshot at the end of the 4 h interval, the reward pool replayed event by event and conserved
the accounting checker over every snapshot the lane took

segments.lane: the whole campaign runs in the P85 recovery lane's own shell (ci-lane x4-exit with run-inputs s4, offence2, accounting, rewards, governance, faults; one job, about 4 h 10 min): chain-dictated phases first, the faults at their offsets (the lane waits for each `at`), a soak, the final reconcile, then the accounting verdict. The faults are lane steps because they act through the lane shell's node control.
segments.driver: scripts/x4pos/driver.py runs once at the end of the lane (x4_report) and VERIFIES every step from the lane's record (lane-check.sh) and runs the accounting checker over the snapshots; it executes nothing. Offsets are from the campaign start, which is the lane's first accounting snapshot.

notCovered.what: a handoff that changes the committee on the accumulated chain (the second handoff here is K to K' with the same four members; the joiner install in the first handoff is the only membership change)
notCovered.coveredBy: the joiner install + recovery in this campaign (bft-core#777) and the PoS rehearsal; a second membership change needs identities beyond the genesis four, and offence 2 leaves fewer than the election's minimum of four eligible

notCovered.what: abort/retry of a prepared handoff on the accumulated state
notCovered.coveredBy: the PoS rehearsal of bft-core#808 and the H6 abort lane (ci-lane kind abort), each on its own fresh state

notCovered.what: a second replacement; an ordinary acknowledged replacement (the lane does the joiner install + recovery, decision (b))
notCovered.coveredBy: the joiner install + recovery in this campaign (bft-core#777, closed as lane wiring)

notCovered.what: an exit by an operator that is not an offender (this lane's one exit is the held offender's, refused on the evidence hold and then claimed)
notCovered.coveredBy: the x4-exit lane without run-inputs s4 (B3b exit steps, bft-core#732 and #774)

notCovered.what: a fault that restarts the evidence collector as a separate process mid-episode
notCovered.coveredBy: the S4 collector holds no runtime state (each `evidence scan` is a new process over the journal copies) and its submitter is killed after admission and rerun in BOTH offences, resuming from the on-chain cursor (submit-1.txt / submit-2.txt in the lane pack); the fault-pair-restart step is the reward-settling side

notCovered.what: an election result that is published and then rejected (this campaign rejects a result that is lost before it is published)
notCovered.coveredBy: the pos-reject stage of the testnet rehearsal (bft-core#866, design test 9), which waits out the reservation lifetime of 16,384 progress rounds on a result nobody drives
